data.one_liner: Read and write images, files, and text to the system clipboard across platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin to access clipboard contents such as images, files, HTML, and text. It supports reading from and writing to the clipboard on mobile, desktop, and web.
use_when: You need to copy or paste files, images, or text programmatically.
Cross‑platform clipboard access is required without writing platform‑specific code.
avoid_when: You only need simple text copy/paste (Clipboard class suffices).
You require advanced clipboard features not covered by this plugin.
strengths: Supports all major platforms including web and desktop.
Handles both read and write for images, files, HTML, and text.
weaknesses: Android requires manual manifest and provider setup.
No built‑in UI components; you must implement your own.
data.setup_notes: On Android add a FileProvider entry in AndroidManifest.xml and create provider_paths.xml as described in the README.
